entries.name: iCalendar: recurrence, events, tasks and free/busy
entries.versionBasis: RFC header; fixed base specification, with later updates listed by RFC Editor.

licence.basis: RFC copyright notice invokes BCP 78 and the Trust Legal Provisions in effect at publication. Preserve document notices; extracted Code Components use the specified BSD terms. Not a blanket BSD licence on prose. This artifact explicitly reserves rights in pre-10-November-2008 material: outside the IETF Standards Process, document modifications/derivatives may require additional permission except RFC formatting and translation. Unchanged document redistribution and Code Component terms must be distinguished from permission to modify the grammar or document.

norn.overlap: Source event/task/recurrence representation; retain TZID, local versus UTC time, recurrence exceptions and free/busy distinctions.

priority.reason: The dogfood workspace needs calendars, contacts and mail.

entries.notes: ABNF is embedded in a machine-readable RFC, not a claimed standalone JSON Schema. Inventory RFC updates/errata before any implementation; this entry is not a complete conformance profile. Redistribution: license-conditions.
